                    ### Question
                    Of the drugs reviewed, which of them does NOT act on the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system ?:

                    ### Options
                    opa. Atenolol.
opb. Captopril.

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Among the drugs reviewed, Atenolol and Minoxidil do not act on the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS). Atenolol is a beta-blocker that primarily affects heart rate and contractility without directly influencing RAAS. Minoxidil is a vasodilator that relaxes vascular smooth muscle and also does not act on RAAS. In contrast, Captopril is an ACE inhibitor that directly inhibits the conversion of angiotensin I to angiotensin II, Eplerenone is an aldosterone antagonist that blocks the effects of aldosterone, and Aliskiren is a direct renin inhibitor that reduces the production of angiotensin I, all of which act on the RAAS.
